subject: Aeroflow pilot: request for extension and closing credit
messages:
From: Lily Santos <lily@aeroflow.health>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor@aeroflow.health>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot wrap + ask: extension and close incentive

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the run so far — the Aeroflow team has been impressed with the latency improvements in the last two weeks. We’re approaching the end of our 30-day pilot (scheduled to finish on Dec 15) and a couple of blockers came up on our side that’ll delay the final evaluation by ~2–3 weeks: procurement needs a final SOW update and our compliance team wants a short retention window tweak for logs.

Would Redwood be open to a short extension and a small credit that would let us finalize the integration and sign a 12-month committed contract? Rough ask from us is: 30–45 day extension + $7k in trial credits (to offset the cost of running a larger test). We can sign the updated SOW and expedite legal once terms are nailed.

I’ve attached the current SOW and their comments as a PDF for context.

Attachments: Aeroflow_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

Let me know if you want to jump on a quick call today — Victor and I are around after 1pm PT.

Best,
Lily Santos
Director, Engineering
Aeroflow Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot wrap + ask: extension and close incentive

Folks — forwarding Aeroflow’s ask. Quick summary: they want a 30–45 day extension and $7k credit to bridge to a committed agreement. Good fit but this is end-of-quarter push territory and I want to make the close happen if we can.

Questions:
- Rishi, what’s our max allowed one-off credit for this AE-managed deal without exec signoff?
- Ben, would you recommend $7k all as usage credit or split usage + premium support?

I’ll plan to respond to them with a concrete proposal today if we can agree. Copying you for quick turnaround.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot wrap + ask: extension and close incentive

Kimberly — thanks for the heads up. From a finance & compliance perspective:

- We can approve up to $5,000 in pure usage credits at the AE level for pilot-to-commit conversion. Anything above that requires manager approval due to revenue recognition and precedent.
- We can pair credits with a 30-day trial extension. Longer extensions (>30 days) need justification (procurement timeline).
- Recommend structuring as $4k usage credit + $1k professional services/premium support credit (total $5k) to keep it within AE approval and show value impact.
- Please ensure procurement signs the SOW change and we include a clause that credits are applied only after contract signature (standard).

HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/AF-2027-1129

If you want the extra $2k (to reach their $7k ask), we’ll need a quick sign-off from the sales manager. Happy to greenlight $5k now so you don’t lose momentum.

—Rishi
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot wrap + ask: extension and close incentive

Agree with Rishi’s recommendation. A split ($4k usage / $1k support) is clean and lets us preserve leverage. If Kimberly wants to push to $7k to speed signing, I’d propose: $6k total — $4.5k usage + $1.5k support — but mark the additional $1k as conditional on a signed 12-month commit within 14 days of extension end. That protects our economics.

Also suggest offering a 30-day extension (not 45) — procurement usually moves faster once SOW is revised; avoid setting a precedent for long trial windows. If you want me to message the manager to approve the extra $1k, I can do that after you confirm.

—Ben
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lily Santos <lily@aeroflow.health>, Victor Huang <victor@aeroflow.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@aeroflow.health
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot wrap + ask: extension and close incentive

Hi Lily / Victor,

Thanks for the clear ask and the SOW comments — appreciate the detail. We want to make this easy and keep momentum toward a 12-month agreement. Here’s what we can commit to today:

1) 30-day pilot extension (new end date: Jan 14, 2028)
2) Trial credit package: $6,000 total, structured as $4,500 usage credits + $1,500 premium-support credits
   - $4,500 in usage credits will apply against token/embedding consumption up to the extension end date
   - $1,500 in premium-support credits can be used for prioritized onboarding hours / scheduled 1:1 with our solutions engineering team
3) We’ll add the requested small log-retention tweak to the SOW and send a revised SOW + DocuSign link for signature. Credits will be applied after signed contract (standard practice).

I’ve attached the revised SOW and the short credit terms for your legal/procurement team to review. If Aeroflow can sign the updated SOW and the 12-month commitment within 14 days after the extended pilot, we’ll convert the conditional portion (the last $1,000) to immediate usage credit as a closing sweetener.

Attachments: Aeroflow_SOW_revised.pdf (pdf), trial-credit-terms.txt (txt)

Would you like to schedule a 30-minute alignment call today at 3pm PT to go over the SOW and next steps?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
